name: FortiSIEM — IOC hunting
description: Analytics filter conditions for FortiSIEM. Attribute names vary between releases and between parsers: validate each template against your own event attribute list before you rely on it.

match.note: FortiSIEM supervisors run on internal hostnames; add yours as a custom target in SOCx settings.

templates.name: Traffic towards the IP addresses
templates.description: Destination side of the flow, as reported by firewalls and network sensors.

templates.name: Traffic in either direction
templates.description: Use when the indicator may be the source of an inbound attack.

templates.name: Web requests containing the domains
templates.description: Proxy and web filter events. CONTAIN is used so that a domain also matches inside a full URL.

templates.name: Events referencing the hashes
templates.description: Endpoint and antivirus events that carry a file hash attribute.

templates.name: Authentications from the IP addresses
templates.description: Combine with an event type filter for logon success or failure in the Analytics editor.
